title: A finite global Ds optimum can be a degenerate exact tie class
statement: An exact N=8, d=2, d_psi=1, K=3 sample has a 31-fold exactly tied global in-bin optimum (all feasible refinements of one reduced bipartition); every tied optimum has exactly coincident projected centroids, so zero first-order violations do not make an optimum compilable, and label-level optima are identified only up to Phi-neutral splits.
